name: MonarchSelectField
title: Select
wrapsNative: MonarchSelectField (a custom Menu with an inline Picker inside the Monarch field box) for forms; the primary example draws the field and a popover listbox of Buttons with a check on the chosen row
summary: A select with the Monarch anatomy: the label above, a 1 point field box with the chosen value and a chevron, and the help or error line below. The options open in the system menu.
whenToUse: To choose one value from a list of up to a few dozen options in a form or a row of settings.
whenNotToUse: For two to four plain-text choices that should all stay visible, use MonarchSegmentedControl or Picker with pickerStyle(.segmented). For a long list that needs search, use MonarchCombobox.
api: MonarchSelectField.init(_ label: String, selection: Binding<Value>, options: [MonarchSelectOption<Value>], prompt: String? = nil, helper: String? = nil, error: String? = nil, isRequired: Bool = false, labelVisibility: Visibility = .visible, labels: MonarchFormFieldLabels = MonarchFormFieldLabels())

appearance: The Monarch field box: 1 point input border, 8 point radius, surface fill, 44 point minimum height (40 and 52 with monarchFieldSize), 14 point value text, a muted chevron. The menu is the system menu.
platformNotes: The Picker with the menu style draws bare text with no box and cannot be restyled, so the field is a Menu whose label is the Monarch box and whose content is an inline Picker. Options, the check mark, scrolling, dismissal and keyboard navigation are the system menu. Android ships MonarchSelect with the same anatomy over an exposed dropdown.
accessibility: The field is one button named by the label, with the chosen text as its value and the help, error and "Required" as its hint.
The visible label and the chevron are hidden from VoiceOver.
The open menu is the system menu: options are read with a selected state on the chosen one.
The box is at least 44 points high and scales with Dynamic Type.
The error has an icon as well as the danger colour, and a new error is announced.
edgeCases: A selection with no matching option shows the prompt.
Options with the same value cannot be told apart; use the model id as the value.
A long title truncates to one line in the field.

examples.title: Status picker
No choice yet, with an error
examples.code:
MonarchSelectField(
    "Priority",
    selection: $priority,
    options: [
        MonarchSelectOption("Low", value: String?.some("low")),
        MonarchSelectOption("High", value: String?.some("high")),
    ],
    prompt: "Choose a priority",
    error: priority == nil ? "Choose a priority." : nil,
    isRequired: true
)
